disclaimer: ILLUSTRATIVE SANDBOX CATALOG. Provider names are fictional. Terms are representative of real European SME financing product *categories* (revenue-based finance, invoice factoring, EU microfinance, inventory/purchase-order finance, bank credit lines, merchant cash advance, equipment lease, public grants) but are not offers, quotes, or descriptions of any real lender's products. Nothing here constitutes financial advice or a credit decision.

cost_model_notes.fixed_installment: Amortising loan. apr is a nominal annual percentage rate; total cost computed on a level-payment amortisation schedule.
cost_model_notes.revenue_share: Fixed total repayment = amount x factor_rate, collected as a share of daily sales. Duration is estimated from the seller's actual sales rate, so the effective APR rises if sales come in faster than expected.
cost_model_notes.factoring: Advance against outstanding receivables/platform balance. Fee charged per 30 days outstanding on the advanced amount.
cost_model_notes.grant: Non-repayable. Cost of capital is zero; the real cost is application effort and reporting obligations.

products.name: NordCap Revenue Advance
products.description: Growth capital repaid as a fixed percentage of daily marketplace sales. No fixed monthly instalment, so repayment slows automatically when sales slow.
products.notes: Best fit for sellers with volatile or seasonal sales who cannot commit to a fixed instalment.

products.name: Helios Revenue Advance Plus
products.description: Larger revenue-share facility for established sellers with clean refund history.
products.notes: Cheaper than entry-level revenue finance but a materially higher eligibility bar.

products.name: BrightBridge Marketplace Factoring
products.description: Advances up to 85% of funds already earned but still held in the marketplace payout queue. Designed specifically to bridge payout hold periods.
products.notes: Cheapest way to solve a pure timing gap, because it is repaid automatically by the next payout rather than out of future profit.

products.name: Meridian Flexible Credit Line
products.description: Revolving credit line. Interest charged only on the drawn balance, so it can sit unused as a safety buffer.
products.notes: Slow to arrange, so it is a facility to put in place before a crunch rather than during one.

products.name: Hanse Inventory & Purchase-Order Finance
products.description: Pays a supplier invoice directly so stock can be bought ahead of a seasonal peak. Repaid once the stock sells through.

terms.collateral_note: The financed inventory itself is the security.

products.notes: Only worth it when the supplier discount or margin on the stock exceeds the financing cost.

products.name: European Microfinance Starter Loan
products.description: Small subsidised term loan for young micro-enterprises, modelled on EU-backed microfinance schemes delivered through national intermediaries.
products.notes: Cheapest debt available to very small or young sellers, but the slowest to arrange. Apply before you need it.

products.name: Lusitania Micro Credit
products.description: Regional microloan for artisan and craft businesses, including sellers with a short trading history.
products.notes: Requires a personal guarantee, which is a real risk for a sole trader to weigh.

products.name: Regional Craft & Digital Trade Grant
products.description: Non-repayable grant for small craft producers investing in digital sales channels, photography or e-commerce tooling.

terms.reporting_obligations: Spend evidence and a short outcome report within 12 months.

products.notes: Free money, but slow, competitive, and requires the seller to co-fund 25% of the project cost.

products.name: SME Digitalisation Voucher
products.description: Voucher scheme covering part of the cost of e-commerce systems, automation or analytics tooling.

terms.reporting_obligations: Itemised invoices and proof of payment.

products.notes: Cannot be used for stock or working capital - capital expenditure and software only.

products.name: SwiftCash Merchant Advance
products.description: Fast lump sum repaid by holding back a large share of daily card settlements.
products.notes: Very expensive. Included deliberately so the copilot can show a seller what the fast option actually costs compared with the alternatives.

products.name: Atlas Business Term Loan
products.description: Conventional amortising business loan with a fixed monthly instalment.

terms.collateral_note: Business assets, and a floating charge in some jurisdictions.

products.notes: Cheapest headline rate in the catalog, with the strictest leverage test and the slowest process.

products.name: Kite Equipment Lease
products.description: Lease for production or fulfilment equipment. The asset is the security, so leverage tests are lighter.
products.notes: Only relevant for equipment purchases - cannot be drawn as working capital.

products.name: Ember Seasonal Bridge
products.description: Short-dated bridge sized to a specific seasonal peak, with interest-only payments until a single balloon repayment.
products.notes: Balloon repayment concentrates all the risk on one date - only sensible if the peak reliably delivers.

products.name: Verde Sustainability Loan
products.description: Discounted term loan for verifiable sustainability investments such as low-waste packaging or energy-efficient equipment.
products.notes: Cheap, but funds are ring-fenced to qualifying sustainability spend and must be evidenced.

products.name: Harbor Business Overdraft
products.description: Small overdraft facility attached to the business current account, intended to absorb short timing mismatches.
products.notes: Expensive per euro but small and flexible. Useful as a backstop rather than a funding source.

products.name: Granary Supplier Payment Terms
products.description: Extends supplier payment terms to 60 or 90 days for a flat fee, without moving cash into the seller's account.
products.notes: Solves a payables timing problem directly. Requires the supplier to accept the arrangement.

products.name: Pinnacle Growth Loan
products.description: Growth loan for scaling sellers with strong margins and low leverage.
products.notes: Deliberately hard to qualify for - useful for showing a seller what they are working towards.

products.name: Orchard Community Enterprise Grant
products.description: Small non-repayable grant for micro-enterprises owned by under-represented founders, with no co-funding requirement.

terms.reporting_obligations: One-page impact update at six months.

products.notes: No co-funding and no repayment, which makes it the single best option for the smallest sellers if they qualify.
